hypotheses.reasoning: POST /v1/notify failures start at 12:00:56 and are 503s from notification-svc (api-gateway 503s from #3685 onward). notification-svc rolled out v3.31.0 with config revision 738 at 12:00:03 (#3385), then at 12:00:28 reloaded config changing TEMPLATE_SVC_URL to http://template-svc.internal:8081 (#3490). Renders succeeded for about 20s, then template-svc stopped answering POST /render after ~12:00:48 (its INFO render lines stop; only DEBUG GC lines continue, #3561, #3592). From 12:00:56 notification-svc gets ECONNREFUSED to 10.25.98.71:8081 (#3580, #3699, #3831, #4015). The endpoint points at a closed port, so the endpoint/host mapping is the most likely fault. Gateway 503s, notif-worker and webhook backlog are downstream symptoms. Unrelated: accounts-db disk full (#2895, #3948) causing /login 500s, and status-poller legacy-inventory timeouts; these don't affect /v1/notify.

Alternative reading: the notification-svc v3.31.0 rollout (config revision 738) introduced the bad endpoint, so the release itself is the fault. Same lines support it, and the rollback target is the same.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back notification-svc config to revision 737 (previous TEMPLATE_SVC_URL) and/or restart notification-svc to pick up the prior endpoint. Verify template-svc is listening on 8081 and that template-svc.internal resolves correctly. Check why template-svc stopped accepting connections at ~12:00:48 while its process kept logging GC. Separately, free disk on accounts-db (99% used, WAL growth) to stop account-svc DiskFullError and /login 500s.
